products.subtitle: Folilock ADVANCE Tablets are a premium nutraceutical hair health supplement formulated to enhance hair strength, shine, and overall vitality. Powered by clinically studied ingredients including Bacopin® and Shoden®, along with Beta-Sitosterol, Biotin, Calcium Pantothenate, Iron, and Niacinamide, this comprehensive formula nourishes hair follicles from within. It helps reduce hair fall, supports stronger roots, and promotes healthier hair growth.
